input_fields.timestamp: naive Asia/Almaty hour-start datetime in training and direct inference
input_fields.wind_speed: float64, m/s, hourly measured average in training
input_fields.temperature: float64, degrees Celsius, hourly measured average in training

missing_policy: reject non-finite and missing values; no imputation

suggested_backend_mapping.timestamp: convert UTC target_start to Asia/Almaty local hour

mapping_limitation: This maps forecast fields to a model trained with measured hourly SCADA means. Operational accuracy is unmeasured.
